applicabilityBasis.summary: CHFAU is a CHF-denominated EMT issued by AllUnity GmbH with a statutory 1:1 Swiss-franc redemption obligation and advertised payment/settlement use. Swiss francs qualify as national-currency monetary value under the GENIUS Act. Its current whitepaper separately disclaims a U.S. offer and restricts U.S. and U.S.-person sales subject to specified Securities Act exemptions and additional U.S.-person definitions; those terms do not establish U.S. approval or a registered foreign-issuer pathway.

genius.notes: Current issuer whitepaper disclaims a U.S. offer and separately restricts U.S./U.S.-person offers or sales, with specified Securities Act exemptions and additional U.S.-person definitions. These terms do not establish a registered GENIUS foreign exception. The 2026-10-07 public-source review found no AllUnity GmbH CHFAU PPSI approval, state-qualified designation, official GENIUS application or foreign-issuer registration. BaFin EMI authorization and the exact ESMA token entry establish EU context only. Direct mint accounts are institutional/professional; public redemption policy provides par redemption subject to identity, AML and banking requirements. Trust Center contains reserve-model disclosures but labels reserve audit reports coming soon; no monthly independent reserve attestation was found. The opened primary issuer-rule implementing materials remain proposals; Treasury SCRC procedure effective September 30 is separate. Expected statutory fallback is January 18, 2027. not-yet-restricted records the current GENIUS timing only and does not override issuer restrictions or other law.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the opened OCC pending-applicant table, implementing proposal scope sections, Treasury/SCRC materials, NYDFS directory and Greenlist, current AllUnity disclosures, and exact-name public regulator searches did not identify an AllUnity GmbH CHFAU GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified designation, official GENIUS application or registered foreign exception. The OCC table concerns general digital-asset bank licensing and is not an exhaustive GENIUS application register. This bounded public-source no-find does not exclude confidential or unindexed filings. AllUnity's public GENIUS commentary welcomes regulatory clarity without announcing a specific U.S. application or registration route.
